name: Firmware Update Package
description: The binary file containing the OS or application software updates for the TCU.

name: Cryptographic Keys
description: Private keys and symmetric keys used for TLS, secure boot, and Secure Onboard Communication (SecOC).

name: Telemetry Data
description: Vehicle speed, location, diagnostics, and driver behavior logs sent to the cloud.

name: Vehicle CAN Bus
description: The internal communication network connecting critical vehicle ECUs.

name: Security Event Logs
description: On-device records of security events, remote commands and OTA actions used for forensics.

name: Boot Configuration and Root of Trust
description: Bootloader, secure boot settings and fuse configuration that anchor software trust.

name: Personal Data
description: Location history, driver identifiers and subscriber data stored or processed by the TCU.

name: Diagnostic Interface
description: OBD-II/UDS diagnostic access used by workshops and tools to read data and reprogram the TCU.

name: Remote Command Channel
description: Backend-to-vehicle channel carrying remote commands such as lock, unlock and immobilise.

name: Cellular Connectivity Service
description: The modem link and SIM/eSIM identity providing cloud connectivity and emergency services.

name: Positioning Data (GNSS)
description: Position and time derived from the GNSS receiver, used for tracking, geofencing and timestamps.

name: Stored Application Software
description: TCU application code and configuration held in external flash memory.
